messages:
mari: Quick sync: MarketForge + CloudPartner go-live next Tues. Plan = marketplace listing + joint webinar (30m demo + 15m Q&A) + co-auth blog. Need inbound lead routing and webinar comms. Who can own routing rules? :rocket:

samir: I can take HubSpot routing. Need clarity: will leads originate from marketplace listing OR webinar signups? Also want UTM conventions.

elaine: I'll own the blog + speaker brief. Can we lock speaker list by EOD Fri? Also need the headshot assets.

jordan: For tracking, I'd recommend utm_campaign=marketforge_launch and source param marketplace|webinar. We'll pipe into Segment -> HubSpot. Will share draft routing map.

mari: Perfect. @samir will you post the HubSpot workflow skeleton? @jordan can you confirm Segment events?

samir: Putting draft here:

```json
{
  "workflow_name": "marketforge_partner_inbound",
  "conditions": [
    {"field":"utm_campaign","equals":"marketforge_launch"},
    {"or":[{"field":"source","equals":"marketplace"},{"field":"source","equals":"webinar"}]}
  ],
  "actions":[
    {"assign":"int-accounts-team"},
    {"add_tag":"partner:cloudpartner"}
  ]
}
```

samir: I'll add team assignment rules and SLA.

jordan: SGTM. Also set contact property 'origin_partner' = 'cloudpartner' for easier segmentation.

mari: Webinar comms: who can draft the email + registration page copy? Need 2 versions (devs + platform leads).

elaine: I'll do dev-focused copy. @mari want platform copy or should I loop growth?

mari: Loop growth pls. Also deadline: final assets by Mon so integration can test marketplace listing.

launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot booked 2025-09-09 10:00 UTC. Calendar invites created.

jordan: I'll set up tracking dashboard in GA & Segment. Sharing link once done.

samir: ETA: routing ready by Mon EOD. Will document rules and share screenshots.

mari: Thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the single source for launch routing. Ping me for blockers.
